name: PennyHelm
description: PennyHelm is an open-source personal finance tracker for managing income, bills, accounts, budgets, debts, and savings goals. Features net worth tracking, optional Plaid bank integration, and CSV/PDF exports. Data is stored locally in SQLite.

notes.text: On first access you will be prompted to load sample data or start fresh. Your data is stored at /opt/pennyhelm/data/finances.db.
Optional Plaid bank integration can be configured by setting PLAID_CLIENT_ID, PLAID_SECRET, and PLAID_ENV in the service environment.
